_README: GPU-PANEL-01 hand-read input for tools/gpu_panel.py. Tier `marketplace` is fetched live by the tool; tiers `on_demand` and `index` are read by hand at the URLs below because they are HTML surfaces whose format can change silently. Copy this file, fill in the price/vintage READ AT THE READING SLOT, and pass it with --reading-date. DO NOT carry a stale price forward — a stale carry-forward is the failure L-16 forbids; drop the vendor instead and let V5 handle the floor. Levels shown are the 2026-09-13 FREEZE RECONNAISSANCE, present as format examples ONLY, never as a reading. V7 (added 2026-10-09) ENFORCES this: every `vintage` must be within 7 days before the reading date (one weekly cadence interval) and not after it; a vendor whose page shows no as-of date keeps vintage UNSPECIFIED and MUST carry `read_on` = the date you read it (within 1 day of the reading date). Fed unedited, this template is REFUSED.
